changes.purpose: Allow sa-build to consume gzip/BGZF or plain input from a non-seekable stdin stream
Stream coordinate-sorted dbNSFP rows directly into the OSA writer with bounded memory
Load chromosome OSA shards from a strict manifest as one fail-closed logical annotation provider
Reopen and fully validate OSA blocks, record JSON, chromosome bounds, and deterministic lookups before promotion
Route explicit custom VCF sources through the same plain/gzip/BGZF stdin reader as built-in sources
Prevent concurrent full transcript-cache builders from exhausting memory across AnnoCAT process lifecycles
Stream strict CADD v1.7 score rows into allele-matched OSA records without staging source tables
Stream strict REVEL v1.3 CSV rows into transcript-tagged allele-matched OSA records without chromosome buffering
Write lossless newline-delimited structured annotations beside VCF output without repeating prediction or supplementary lookups
Retain AnnoCAT's versioned 135-field dbNSFP 4.9a contract without collapsing transcript-aligned values
Apply a validated dbNSFP field subset per installation and avoid redundant full JSON reparsing during cache verification
Validate and retain configurable field subsets for ClinVar, dbSNP, gnomAD, phyloP, CADD, SpliceAI, and REVEL caches
Own raw indexed-source framing and multi-artifact merging in fastVEP while removing redundant cache-writer cloning and sorting
Ignore an incomplete trailing text row at BGZF range boundaries while preserving complete full-file inputs
Build all configurable supplementary caches with reusable input buffers, direct selected-field serialization, and overlapped ordered OSA compression
Parse stateless supplementary source rows in bounded ordered batches with a configurable one-to-four worker budget
Keep explicitly supplied transcript caches read-only during annotation so an annotation run cannot overwrite an installed cache
Fully decode and structurally verify staged transcript caches before installation, including primary coding-sequence coverage
Summarize coding transcripts on contigs absent from the selected FASTA instead of emitting one warning per transcript
Memory-map indexed FASTA files during transcript-cache construction instead of loading the complete genome into RAM

notes: Pinned to the tested annocat/cache-build-performance fork commit. The release artifact keeps explicit transcript caches read-only during annotation, memory-maps indexed FASTA files during transcript-cache construction, and fully verifies staged transcript caches before installation. It also owns raw BGZF range framing, safe trailing-row handling, chromosome filtering, sorted multi-artifact merging, bounded stdin streaming, bounded ordered supplementary parsing, direct configurable-field serialization, overlapped ordered OSA compression, fast shard verification, manifest-backed chromosome shards, transcript-cache build locking, and single-pass structured output beside annotated VCF.
